title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

  • Hands-on experience with VMware environments

  • Strong incident management experience, including response and resolution processes


Core Skills & Competencies

  • Solid understanding of infrastructure performance metrics (CPU, memory, disk, etc.)
  • Experience with alert tuning and optimization
  • Ability to proactively detect and troubleshoot performance issues
  • Strong incident management and operational response capabilities


Screening Signals

Look for candidates who:

  • Understand CPU Ready thresholds and their impact on performance
  • Have hands-on experience tuning alerts to reduce noise
  • Can proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks
  • Demonstrate strong incident management experience in production environments

  • Identificar oportunidades comerciais e propor ações para fortalecimento das vendas e aumento de presença da marca nos clientes;
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado, movimentações da concorrência e oportunidades regionais de execução comercial;
  • Atuar próximo ao time Comercial apoiando negociações, desenvolvimento de clientes e ações estratégicas no PDV;
  • Garantir execução adequada de campanhas, eventos e ações promocionais junto aos clientes;
  • Realizar feedbacks, acompanhamentos de rotina e ações de desenvolvimento com o time de promotores;
  • Controlar despesas operacionais da equipe, incluindo deslocamentos, reembolsos e demais custos da operação;
  • Fortalecer relacionamento com clientes, equipes comerciais e áreas internas parceiras.

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior com gestão de equipes de campo, merchandising, execução comercial ou promoção de vendas;

  • Experiência com rotinas comerciais e acompanhamento de indicadores de performance;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Boa comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade de influência;
  • Perfil organizado, dinâmico e orientado para resultados;
  • CNH categoria B ativa e disponibilidade para viagens.
